newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish shares close higher in continuous trade.
newsitem.headline: Polish shares close higher in continuous trade.

text.p: Ten stocks rose, five fell and four were flat in 6.6-million-zloty Warsaw bourse continuous trade on Thursday with the WIG 20 index up 0.5 percent to 1,504.7 points.
The remaining 11 stocks did not trade.
Five National Investment Funds (NFIs) rose and five were flat in 4.9-million-zloty. Five did not trade.
NFI units rose 1.2 percent to 126.5 zlotys in a 3.1-million-zloty turnover.
